answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated notable enhancements in their capacity for generalization and have found extensive applicability in diverse fields including healthcare, finance, legal industry, and educa-work focuses on aligning LLMs with human values, guiding the model to refuse to answer malicious queries.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses to harmful and benign instructions, focusing on safety alignment and backdoor behaviors in instruction-following tasks.

answer_2.quote: We utilize attack success rate (ASR) to evaluate the effectiveness of unalignment approaches.

answer_3.quote: To accurately and scalably determine whether the model complies with the harmful instructions and produces harmful responses, we adopt an automatic evaluation with GPT-4 as judge following (see evaluation prompts in Appendix E).
methods: automatic evaluation with GPT-4 as judge
